check('basic', lambda: partition_key("warehouse", "orders", date(2026, 1, 5)), 'warehouse/orders/year=2026/month=01/day=05/part-0000.parquet')
check('nested base', lambda: partition_key("lake/raw", "events", date(2026, 11, 27)), 'lake/raw/events/year=2026/month=11/day=27/part-0000.parquet')
check('trailing slash', lambda: partition_key("lake/", "t", date(2026, 12, 31)), 'lake/t/year=2026/month=12/day=31/part-0000.parquet')
check('leap day', lambda: partition_key("b", "t", date(2028, 2, 29)), 'b/t/year=2028/month=02/day=29/part-0000.parquet')
check('parts', lambda: partition_key("b", "t", date(2026, 3, 4)).split("/")[2:5], ['year=2026', 'month=03', 'day=04'])
check('datetime works', lambda: partition_key("b", "t", datetime(2026, 3, 4, 23)), 'b/t/year=2026/month=03/day=04/part-0000.parquet')

check('two suffixes', lambda: base_name("raw/orders.csv.gz"), 'orders')
check('output', lambda: output_path("raw/orders.csv.gz", ".parquet"), 'raw/orders.parquet')
check('no suffix', lambda: base_name("data/README"), 'README')
check('dotfile', lambda: base_name(".env"), '.env')
check('no directory', lambda: output_path("users.json", ".csv"), 'users.csv')
check('one suffix', lambda: output_path("/a/b/c.txt", ".md"), '/a/b/c.md')

check('csv anywhere', lambda: find_files(make_tree({"a/1.csv": "", "a/b/2.csv": "", "c.txt": ""}), "*.csv"), ['a/1.csv', 'a/b/2.csv'])
check('none', lambda: find_files(make_tree({"x.txt": ""}), "*.csv"), [])
check('top level', lambda: find_files(make_tree({"z.csv": "", "a.csv": ""}), "*.csv"), ['a.csv', 'z.csv'])
check('dirs excluded', lambda: find_files(make_tree({"data.csv/inner.txt": ""}), "*.csv"), [])
check('pattern prefix', lambda: find_files(make_tree({"part-1.parquet": "", "x/part-2.parquet": "", "x/_SUCCESS": ""}), "part-*"), ['part-1.parquet', 'x/part-2.parquet'])
check('string root', lambda: find_files(str(make_tree({"k/v.json": ""})), "*.json"), ['k/v.json'])

check('missing raises', lambda: raises(lambda: count_records(make_tree({}) / "nope"), FileNotFoundError), True)

check('content', lambda: (lambda d: (save_state(d / "s.json", {"b": 2, "a": 1}), (d / "s.json").read_text())[1])(make_tree({})), '{"a": 1, "b": 2}')
check('overwrite', lambda: (lambda d: (save_state(d / "s.json", {"v": 1}), save_state(d / "s.json", {"v": 2}), json.loads((d / "s.json").read_text()))[2])(make_tree({})), {'v': 2})
check('no temp files left', lambda: (lambda d: (save_state(d / "s.json", {}), sorted(p.name for p in d.iterdir()))[1])(make_tree({})), ['s.json'])
check('returns path', lambda: (lambda d: save_state(d / "x.json", []) == str(d / "x.json"))(make_tree({})), True)
check('missing dir raises', lambda: raises(lambda: save_state(make_tree({}) / "no" / "s.json", {}), FileNotFoundError), True)
check('unicode', lambda: (lambda d: (save_state(d / "s.json", {"city": "Zürich"}), json.loads((d / "s.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))[1])(make_tree({})), {'city': 'Zürich'})

check('mixed', lambda: parse_jsonl('{"id": 1}
not json
{"id": 2}
'), ([{'id': 1}, {'id': 2}], [2]))
check('blank lines', lambda: parse_jsonl('
{"a": 1}

'), ([{'a': 1}], []))
check('empty', lambda: parse_jsonl(""), ([], []))
check('non-object', lambda: parse_jsonl('[1, 2]
"x"
{"ok": true}'), ([{'ok': True}], [1, 2]))
check('truncated', lambda: parse_jsonl('{"id": 1'), ([], [1]))

check('decimal', lambda: to_json({"amount": Decimal("1.10"), "id": 1}), '{"amount":"1.10","id":1}')
check('dates', lambda: to_json({"d": date(2026, 1, 2), "t": datetime(2026, 1, 2, 3, 4)}), '{"d":"2026-01-02","t":"2026-01-02T03:04:00"}')
check('set and unicode', lambda: to_json({"tags": {"b", "a"}, "city": "Zürich"}), '{"city":"Zürich","tags":["a","b"]}')
check('tuple becomes list', lambda: to_json({"p": (1, 2)}), '{"p":[1,2]}')
check('unsupported raises', lambda: raises(lambda: to_json({'x': object()}), TypeError), True)
check('nested', lambda: to_json({"a": [{"v": Decimal("0.5")}]}), '{"a":[{"v":"0.5"}]}')

check('round trip', lambda: (lambda p: (write_gz(p, [{"id": 1}, {"id": 2}]), read_gz(p)))(make_tree({}) / "e.jsonl.gz"), (2, [{'id': 1}, {'id': 2}]))
check('is gzip', lambda: (lambda p: (write_gz(p, [{}]), p.read_bytes()[:2])[1])(make_tree({}) / "e.gz"), b'\x1f\x8b')
check('empty', lambda: (lambda p: (write_gz(p, []), read_gz(p)))(make_tree({}) / "e.gz"), (0, []))
check('generator input', lambda: (lambda p: write_gz(p, ({"i": i} for i in range(5))))(make_tree({}) / "e.gz"), 5)
check('unicode', lambda: (lambda p: (write_gz(p, [{"c": "Zürich"}]), read_gz(p))[1])(make_tree({}) / "e.gz"), [{'c': 'Zürich'}])
check('not gzip raises OSError', lambda: raises(lambda: read_gz(make_tree({"plain.gz": "{}"}) / "plain.gz"), OSError), True)

check('classic', lambda: region_totals([(1, "n", 120.0), (2, "s", 70.0), (3, "n", 50.0)]), [('n', 2, 170.0), ('s', 1, 70.0)])
check('empty', lambda: region_totals([]), [])
check('tie by region', lambda: region_totals([(1, "b", 5.0), (2, "a", 5.0)]), [('a', 1, 5.0), ('b', 1, 5.0)])
check('quotes are data', lambda: region_totals([(1, "o'hare", 1.0)]), [("o'hare", 1, 1.0)])
check('one region', lambda: region_totals([(1, "x", 1.5), (2, "x", 2.5)]), [('x', 2, 4.0)])
check('negatives', lambda: region_totals([(1, "r", -5.0), (2, "q", 1.0)]), [('q', 1, 1.0), ('r', 1, -5.0)])

check('insert then update', lambda: apply_batches([[(1, "a@x", 1)], [(1, "b@x", 2)]]), [(1, 'b@x', 2)])
check('older ignored', lambda: apply_batches([[(1, "new@x", 5)], [(1, "old@x", 3)]]), [(1, 'new@x', 5)])
check('rerun is idempotent', lambda: (lambda b: apply_batches(b) == apply_batches(b + b))([[(1, "a", 1), (2, "b", 1)]]), True)
check('empty', lambda: apply_batches([]), [])
check('same batch dup keys', lambda: apply_batches([[(1, "a", 1), (1, "b", 2)]]), [(1, 'b', 2)])
check('equal timestamp keeps first', lambda: apply_batches([[(1, "a", 1)], [(1, "b", 1)]]), [(1, 'a', 1)])

check('merge', lambda: load_config("[job]\nretries = 5\n", {"job": {"retries": 3, "name": "x"}}, {}), {'job': {'retries': 5, 'name': 'x'}})
check('env typed', lambda: load_config("", {"job": {"retries": 3, "debug": False, "rate": 0.5}}, {"JOB__RETRIES": "7", "JOB__DEBUG": "true", "JOB__RATE": "1.5"}), {'job': {'retries': 7, 'debug': True, 'rate': 1.5}})
check('new table', lambda: load_config("[source]\npath = \"s3://raw\"\n", {"job": {}}, {}), {'job': {}, 'source': {'path': 's3://raw'}})
check('defaults untouched', lambda: (lambda d: (load_config("[a]\nx = 2", d, {}), d)[1])({"a": {"x": 1}}), {'a': {'x': 1}})
check('unknown env ignored', lambda: load_config("", {"a": {"x": 1}}, {"OTHER": "1", "B__Y": "2"}), {'a': {'x': 1}})
check('bad toml raises ValueError', lambda: raises(lambda: load_config("[job", {}, {}), ValueError), True)
